title: Privacy Policy | AMK Digital Agency
description: What information the AMK Digital Agency website collects, why, how long it is kept, who processes it and the choices and rights you have.

blocks.html: Last updated: 18 November 2026. This page is a draft and is not yet published.

This policy explains how the AMK Digital Agency website handles information when you read its pages, use its free SEO tools or send a request. It covers this website only. The separate AMK Digital Agency App has its own terms and privacy information.

The website is operated by [TO BE CONFIRMED: legal name of the business owner or registered business, and country of registration], trading as AMK Digital Agency. Contact for privacy requests: [TO BE CONFIRMED: contact email address for legal and privacy requests].

blocks.html: We do not use analytics or advertising cookies, we do not sell personal information, and the website does not take payments.

blocks.text: Legal bases (where the GDPR or UK GDPR applies)

items: Legitimate interests: running the free tools, counting free runs and protecting the service from abuse.
Consent: answering a request you send with the form (you tick a box to agree). You can withdraw consent at any time.
Strictly necessary storage: the visitor cookie is needed for the free-run limits you ask to use.

blocks.html: These companies process information on our behalf to run the website:

items: Vercel: hosting. Servers that run the tools are in the United States (Washington, D.C. region). Vercel keeps technical logs, which can include IP addresses, under its own policies.
Upstash: database for usage counters and, if no other destination is set, request form submissions. Region: United States (east).
Cloudflare Turnstile: a security check that tells people from automated traffic. Cloudflare processes information such as your IP address and browser signals for this purpose.
Public sources a tool reads: the website you ask a tool to check, the domain registries (RDAP or WHOIS) and DNS. These receive only what is needed for the check.

blocks.html: The website has an AI chat assistant that is currently switched off. If it is switched on, messages you type would be sent to an AI provider (Google or OpenRouter) to produce a reply; this policy will be updated before that happens.

Our service providers process information in the United States. Where the law requires it, transfers rely on the providers' contractual safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses. [TO BE CONFIRMED: safeguards in place with each provider]

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or receive a copy of your personal information, to object to or restrict processing, and to withdraw consent. People in the EU and UK can also complain to their data protection authority. Residents of California may have rights under the CCPA/CPRA; we do not sell or share personal information for cross-context behavioural advertising.

To use a right, contact [TO BE CONFIRMED: contact email address for legal and privacy requests]. We may need to confirm your request before acting on it. We will answer within the time the applicable law requires.

blocks.title: For legal review
blocks.html: Check which laws apply based on where the business is established and who it targets, including Pakistan's data protection requirements, the GDPR/UK GDPR and US state laws. Do not state compliance with any law until this review is done.

The website uses encrypted connections (HTTPS), stores IP addresses only as keyed hashes, signs the visitor cookie so it cannot be forged, and limits how often each tool can be used. No method of storage or transfer is completely secure.
The website is meant for adults and businesses. It is not directed at children under [TO BE CONFIRMED: minimum age, for example 16], and we do not knowingly collect their information.
We will update this page when our practices change and show the date of the latest version at the top.
